title: Forty-Six Domains
style: progressive jazz 132 bpm female singer withthat crackle in her voice. , double bass cello
lyrics:
Title: "Forty-Six and Counting" Style: Indie-folk ballad

Verse 1 Forty-six domains on the Cloudflare wire Only one's on Pro, the rest on Free attire Five Workers humming, ten Pages deployed Four KV namespaces, one D1 employed Two R2 buckets holding what you've built One AI Gateway with a fifty-per-minute tilt And kamals.pro sitting on the other account Free plan too — that's the whole amount

Chorus Forty-six and counting, but what's missing from the stack? No Turnstile spinning, no Access watching your back No Zero Trust tunnel, no Stream for your screen No Images serving, no Waiting Room scene You've built a foundation, but the house is half-done Let me tell you what you're missing, one by one

Verse 2 You've got Workers AI through the gateway door But no Vectorize index to search what you store No Durable Objects for state that persists No Queues for the messages that exist in the mist No Hyperdrive to speed up your database calls No Workflows to orchestrate your app's waterfalls No Browser Rendering to scrape or to test No Email Routing — where do the messages rest?

Bridge Tailscale's your VDS, you're weighing the path Pages for static or Workers for math coreintent.dev's proxied, zynthio.ai too But Bot Fight Mode's scattered — some on, some askew One hundred twenty-three insights still glowing red Forty-four Free zones with no Pro ahead The wrabbit domains need the most attention AI bots crawling without intervention

Verse 3 What you could have if you flipped the switch: Turnstile on every form — no more bot glitch Access for zero-trust login flow Tunnels instead of exposing your VDS below Workers AI with caching and logs Vectorize for semantic search through your catalogs Durable Objects for real-time state Queues for async work that shouldn't wait Images for optimization on the fly Stream for video without supply-chain tie Email Routing so zynthio.ai gets its mail Waiting Rooms when traffic hits the scale

Outro Forty-six and counting, the stack wants to grow The Free plan's a start, but the Pro plan's the show One domain's Pro already — coreyai.ai leads The rest could follow if that's what you need I'm not stopping now, I'm not hitting pause When the incident clears, I'll fix every cause Bot Fight Mode, HSTS, HTTPS Always On Every insight flagged — every single one
